findings.evidence: Lines 200–202 rewrite `q (totalSpaceHomeomorphOfRangeEq ... e)` to `p e`; lines 213–216 provide the symmetric rewrite.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to both pointwise lemmas so applications of the chosen homeomorphism and its inverse simplify without unfolding.
findings.issue: The forward and inverse pointwise over-base laws are normal-form lemmas but neither `apply_totalSpaceHomeomorphOfRangeEq` nor `apply_totalSpaceHomeomorphOfRangeEq_symm` is tagged `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: Line 227 adds only `deckMulEquivOfRangeEq_apply_coe`, while `Deck/Conjugation.lean` provides both `conjMulEquiv_apply_coe` and `conjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe`.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp] deckMulEquivOfRangeEq_symm_apply_coe` lemma specialized from `Deck.conjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe`.
findings.issue: `deckMulEquivOfRangeEq` exposes only the forward evaluation rule, leaving evaluation through its inverse without a specialized characteristic lemma.

summary: The chosen homeomorphism and deck-group equivalence lack parts of their characteristic simplification API.
